statement: For the graph G = C_3 square C_3, interpreted exactly as the 4-regular graph on Z_3^2 in problem.md, the adjacent-vertex-distinguishing total chromatic number is chi''_a(G) = 6. The scope includes an explicit proper AVD total coloring from the palette {1,2,3,4,5,6} and a proof excluding every palette size k < 6.
contribution: A complete self-contained resolution of the frozen exact-value question: a local cardinality argument proves the lower bound for every smaller palette, and a serialized assignment with a deterministic verifier proves the matching upper bound. No novelty or priority claim is made because the full theorem text of the potentially relevant Tian--Chen--Shao--Wang (2014) paper was not accessible in this bounded pass.
